svg.title: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B W4A8 (experts int4, GDN W8A8) single-chip SWE concurrency speed-throughput tradeoff
svg.desc: Only client concurrency changes within the single-chip W4A8 real-MTP2 series. Every point is one 900s closed-loop observation on one Ascend 910B3 chip at max-num-seqs 16.

g.text: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B W4A8 · single-chip SWE prefix reuse
TP1 · 1×910B3 · FULL_DECODE_ONLY · MNS16 · real MTP2 · int4 experts + GDN W8A8 · 900s/point

g.text: W4A8 (GDN W8A8) + real MTP2 · int4 experts / int8 rest · bf16 KV
P90 request decode speed · output tokens/s
The line connects all five measured client C levels (C1/C2/C4/C8/C16); it is not a fitted curve or a cross-setting Pareto envelope.

One server instance, 33.49 GiB KV set explicitly for this artifact (5.46 lanes at 262144 tokens), so prefix reuse survives C16 and C16 is the measured peak. The KV budget is a deployment choice, not an int4 property; W4A8 vs W8A8/BF16 differs in precision and KV budget, so no cross-precision speedup claim.
